description: Block changes to what proves the work (the flow file, files a step's verify reads, the flot store) and to what decides whether it is checked (CI workflows, git hooks, Claude Code settings and plugins, the flot binary), whether by an edit tool, a shell command that names the file or the directory holding it, or any other tool whose input names it; block downloaded code piped into an interpreter and the flot commands that change whose evidence counts; and, where a flow is, block a call the guard cannot judge.
